title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
shortTitle: Journey to the Center of the Earth
author: Jules Verne
blurb: Why is the translation history of Verne in particular such a mess? Why is the most popular version of this book on Project Gutenberg a mangled rewritten edition with Anglicized character names? Why does no physical scan of the Malleson edition exist literally anywhere on the internet? (Resolved!)
blurb2: The chud George Orwell: "Like most writers, Jules Verne was one of those people to whom nothing ever happens." (link) The chad Extraordinary Adventures: "Everything he wrote about in his novels, Jules Verne actually experienced first-hand." (link). (Also from that same Orwell essay: "one can see the justification for Hitler".)
